purpose: Test whether bounded fixed-length IK suppresses known corruptions without suppressing known motion or promoting missing measurements.
real_replay_limit: No independent 3D truth. Anatomical constraints and lower speed tails alone cannot establish accuracy. MediaPipe world coordinates are hip centered.
real_comparison: Match frame_id, epoch and source_pts_ms; compare the exact same raw input and joint masks.
Keep raw observed/uncertain/lost states distinct from fitted or predicted model coordinates.
Report full cohort and shared-measured subset; count resets, solver failures, unavailable outputs and extra runtime.
Separate structural bone/range compliance from raw fit residual, motion amplitude, lag and recovery.
Treat fitted projection as a 2D consistency proxy unless source camera calibration is known.
Do not count repeated source loops as independent movements or include context resets in velocity metrics.

synthetic_checks.name: clean_model_motion
segments: full yaw turn across angle wrap
synthetic_checks.position_error_limit: 1 percent of median major limb length

synthetic_checks.name: missing_and_recovery
synthetic_checks.hard_failure: Any unobserved joint certified as observed

synthetic_checks.name: frozen_negative_control
synthetic_checks.output: First fitted pose for every time
synthetic_checks.required_outcome: Fail motion-amplitude or known-truth accuracy gate despite zero temporal jumps

structural_review: Actual constrained-coordinate enforcement, axes, ordering and units
Free root versus hidden global clamps
No speed clamps or adaptive metrics that predetermine success
interpretation: Thresholds above are engineering prototype acceptance checks, not clinical or anatomical validation. Passing synthetic tests does not imply correct pose on real images.
